items.text: Round 2 decisions were incorporated into conclusion.md: reconciliation runs as an in-process goroutine ticker (d1=A), anomaly alerts POST to a configurable webhook URL (d2=B), and the research is treated as complete with implementation details deferred to execute items (d3=A).

The conclusion now has a filled Summary, 8 evidence-backed findings (original 5 plus webhook atomicity gap, intro_anomaly_log generalization target, and credit-reversal ad-hocness), a Decisions Made section capturing d1/d2/d3 selections, an honest Limitations section, and 6 concrete Actions corresponding to the 6 downstream backlog items identified in round 2.

Action dependency chain is explicit: Action 1 (atomicity fix) blocks Action 2 (reconciliation ticker); Action 3 (anomaly log + webhook alerts) blocks Action 4 (download confirmation) and Action 5 (admin ops); Action 2 and 3 both block Action 5; Action 5 and 3 block Action 6 (dashboard). Downstream workshop can queue these in topological order directly.

Readiness held at 3/3/3/2/2. testable and risk_awareness are honest 2s because threshold values (Action 3), exact anomaly-type catalogue, and retry/signing policy for the outbound webhook are deliberately deferred to the execute items — noted as such in Limitations. Research scope stays bounded.

Remaining gaps worth flagging: Stripe Dashboard/Radar coverage was not inventoried, so Action 3 should verify before building duplicate detections; the end-to-end destination of logStructured() output is unverified, which could change where alerting is best built; threshold tuning needs production baseline data. These are called out in conclusion.md's Limitations section and belong to the execute items rather than another research round.

plan_updates: Finalized conclusion.md by incorporating round-2 answers (d1=A in-process goroutine ticker, d2=B configurable webhook alert URL, d3=A ready to conclude) that round-2's plan_updates described but did not actually write. Added Summary, three new findings (webhook atomicity gap, intro_anomaly_log generalization target, credit-reversal ad-hocness), a new Decisions Made During Research section, an expanded Limitations section, and six concrete Actions (Action 1 fix atomicity, Action 2 reconciliation ticker, Action 3 payment anomaly log + webhook alerts, Action 4 download confirmation tracking, Action 5 admin payment ops, Action 6 optional monetization dashboard) each with kind/priority/effort/acceptance_allow/depends_on populated.
